description: This file defines the ConnectionWatchdog class responsible for monitoring and managing the connection status within the application. It uses a Swing Timer to periodically attempt reconnection by invoking LinkManager.restart() upon data arrival/event triggers.

classes.name: ConnectionWatchdog
classes.description: A utility class managing connection stability by periodically attempting to restart the connection when data is received or events occur.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes connection monitoring by setting up event listeners and starting the reconnection timer.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Resets/restarts the reconnect timer whenever new data arrives, facilitating reconnection attempts.
